name: Reeling Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You can give your spells an added punch, creating openings for your allies.

Benefit: Spells cast with this feat strike targets hard and leave them unsteady as the magic reverberates within.

Whenever a spell modified by this feat deals hit point damage to a creature, that creature is flat-footed for a number of rounds equal to the level of the spell.

Level Increase: +2
